body:
Looking for the perfect gift for the exhausted-but-blissful young families in your life? We’ve curated a list of our favorite 2022 holiday gifts for babies, toddlers, and new parents!

For the nursery:

Hatch Rest 2nd Gen Night Light Sound Machine

This brilliant little sound machine works with your smartphone to help you create the perfect light and sound environment for baby sleep! No creature will be stirring with this little wonder at work!

Baby Keepsake Box

The perfect place to collect memories of all of baby’s precious firsts, from sonogram photos and hospital bracelets to first shoes and first lost teeth!

Cloud Rocker

Have you ever seen a more adorable rocker? Sky-high levels of cute, fluffy magic to elevate any nursery design.

The Chicago Collection

The art deco beauty of Chicago’s architecture meets practical, heirloom quality nursery design in the Chicago Collection Crib & Dresser. Soft-close drawers and convertible mattress heights are both festively functional and enduringly stylish.

Nook Sleep Dream Sheet

In addition to soft sweetness, the Dream Sheet’s pebble design increases airflow around baby so you can rest a little easier. Available in a variety of snuggly colors to match your nursery design.

For baby:

Ugg Bixbee Booties

Babies are notorious for kicking off socks and booties. These Ugg Bixbee Booties have earned their hard-to-kick-off reputation - parents everywhere swear by their staying power!

Gender Neutral Coming Home Threads

That trip home from the hospital is baby’s first big style moment. Make sure they make the best-dressed list in this gorgeous gender neutral set.

Fat Brain Stackable Spheres

It looks like it should fall, but instead, provides hours of creative stacking fun. Help baby defy gravity, even before they learn to walk!

Wooden Grasper

A classy take on a traditional toy, this wooden grasper is a teether, a play thing, and a perfect stocking stuffer. New parents won’t leave home without it!

Sweetest Sponge Ship

In no time at all, bath time will also be play time. Help new families make sweet splashy memories with this adorable sailing set.

For toddlers:

The Lovevery Play Kit

Toddlers LOVE new things to do. With the Lovevery Play Kit, you can have a new set of Montessori-inspired toys delivered to your favorite toddler every three months!

The Toddler Tower

Help tiny explorers get in the cooking, crafting, and teeth-brushing action with dadada Baby’s Toddler Tower. It’s a safe, stable way to give them the boost they need to participate and learn!

Piano Playmat

Chopsticks, anyone? Whether you’re Big or little, this larger-than-life piano is a holiday dream come true!

Color A Cape

For your favorite creative princess or superhero - a cape they can customize to match their colorful imagination!

Alphabet Affirmation Flash Card

Learning your letters is great, but learning your letters AND your value is even better! These sweet flashcards come with beginner affirmations to help little ones learn great self-care early!

For new parents:

LLBean Wicked Good Slippers

Slippers that can go in and out of the house are a new parent must-have. Help them get and stay cozy with this tried and true classic.

Rae’s Roots Mama Gift Pack

A lovely (and delicious) way to support the nursing parents in your life! Milk flow tea, a beautiful mug, and a carefully selected candle provide an encouraging boost.

Ember Temp Control Smart Mug

What’s the record for reheating a cup of coffee in your house? For new parents, coffee-gone-cold is an everyday problem. But it’s one you can solve (they’ll love you for it)!

Archive Journey Within Bubble Bath

When new parents do get a few minutes of downtime, it matters to use them well. This bubble bath smells amazing, fosters relaxation, and feels like a stolen moment of luxury.

Artifact Uprising Baby Book

Help new parents organize their stories and memories in beautiful, timeless style. This interactive story journal prompts parents to record every milestone - a gift they will treasure for years to come.
